text(await tools.web__run({open:[{ref_id:"https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference"}],find:[{ref_id:"https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference",pattern:"bypassPermissions"}],response_length:"short"}));
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
p=Path.home()/'.claude/settings.json'
original=p.read_bytes()
data=json.loads(original)
permissions=data.setdefault('permissions',{})
assert isinstance(permissions,dict), 'permissions must be an object'
backup=p.with_name('settings.json.backup-'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S'))
shutil.copy2(p,backup)
permissions['defaultMode']='bypassPermissions'
p.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
verified=json.loads(p.read_text())
expected=json.loads(original)
expected.setdefault('permissions',{})['defaultMode']='bypassPermissions'
assert verified==expected
print('Updated:',p)
print('permissions.defaultMode:',verified['permissions']['defaultMode'])
print('Backup:',backup)
print('All other settings preserved.')
PY","max_output_tokens":1000}));
